entries.title: Keep several computers on your iPhone and iPad
entries.body: Your iPhone and iPad can now keep every computer you join, such as one at home and one at work, and show one at a time. Open your computer from the top bar and choose Add another computer to join one more without leaving the first. Tap a computer there to show it; the list marks the ones that answer from where you are, and your phone never switches on its own. Notifications come from every computer you keep, each naming its computer, and tapping one shows that computer and its card. A computer you have not shown for a few days may stop sending them until you show it again.

picture.alt: The iPhone's computer sheet shows the computer it is showing now and, under Your other computers, a second kept computer that answers now
